name: The Divided Will
origin: Original source-based public study; never copied from private Theosis graph

nodes.label: Why does intention fail to become action?
nodes.text: An invitation to examine the moment intention gives way to reaction.

nodes.label: Romans 7:15–25
nodes.text: Paul's discussion of wanting to do good and acting otherwise belongs to an argument about sin, law and deliverance.

nodes.label: Changing inner 'I's
nodes.text: Fourth Way teaching describes changing and sometimes conflicting inner 'I's; this is a doctrinal concept in that tradition, not clinically verified psychology.

nodes.label: Self-observation
nodes.text: Observing shifting states rather than identifying immediately with them is a recurring Fourth Way practice.

nodes.label: Nicoll's inner reading of the Gospels
nodes.text: The New Man interprets Gospel material psychologically; it does not make Romans 7 a Fourth Way text.
